svg.title: A quadtree over 70 drivers with at most 4 per leaf
svg.desc: 70 points, 45 of them clustered downtown. Each cell splits into four when it holds more than 4 points, giving 40 leaf cells: depth 5 in the dense centre, depth 1 or 2 in the outskirts.
svg.text: quadtree: split any cell holding more than 4 drivers
